title: i18n(da): re-sync index_da.html with English Apr 28–29 rewrites
body:
`index_da.html` was ~294 lines and 7 weeks behind English after 4 commits rewrote the hero narrative, added new structural sections, and fixed SEO/JSON-LD. This PR brings Danish to parity.

## Meta & SEO
- **Title** → `AI-drevet Demokratisk Transparens | Politisk Efterretningsmedie | Hack23`
- Meta description, OG title/description, Twitter card — all rewritten to 62 MCP tools / 11 agentic workflows narrative; `og:updated_time` → `2026-04-29`

## JSON-LD
- `WebSite` and `WebPage` `inLanguage` fixed: `"en"` → `"da"`
- Added three missing structured-data objects: `#riksdagsmonitor`, `#euparliamentmonitor`, `#european-parliament-mcp-server`
- EP-MCP `codeRepository` corrected to `github.com/Hack23/European-Parliament-MCP-Server`
- `dateModified` → `2026-04-29`

## Hero Section
- `hero-tagline` now carries the OSINT-disruption narrative; `intro-tagline` differentiated to the "ISMS-governed political-intelligence media empire" framing
- CTA buttons reordered: AI news first, consulting second
- **Live-platforms bar** added (5 platform links)
- Business-lines reordered (AI media → CIA → Compliance Manager → Consulting → BT) with updated metrics: `11 agentiske arbejdsgange`, `62 MCP-værktøjer`

## Political Intelligence Section
- Cards reordered: **EP-MCP → CIA → Riksdagsmonitor → EUPM**
- EP-MCP card updated: 62 tools (15 OSINT + 47), 1 130+ unit tests, OpenSSF 7.2/10
- CIA card: new 6-framework / 50-risk-rule / 349-MP copy
- Riksdagsmonitor: 11 agentic workflows, 109 000+ docs
- EUPM: 8 agentic GitHub workflows, 62-tool reference
- **Portfolio comparison table** (4 rows — Riksdagsmonitor, EUPM, EP MCP, CIA) with OpenSSF/SLSA/DeepWiki badges
- **Trust & Verification statement** (Apache-2.0, CodeQL, OpenSSF > 7.0, SLSA L3, DeepWiki)

## Products Section
- CodeQL / OpenSSF Scorecard / SLSA (or npm) inline badges added to all three product cards
- API/Docs deep links (`📚 Docs`) added for Black Trigram, CIA Compliance Manager, and Citizen Intelligence Agency

## Preserved
- `lang="da"`, `og:locale=da_DK`, canonical and `og:url` → `index_da.html`
- All 14-language hreflang tags + `x-default`
- Footer language switcher — Danish marked `aria-current="page"`
- All external URLs, `@id` values, and brand names untouched
